scripts.build: vite build && vue-tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/build-assets.mjs
scripts.check:print: pnpm build && pnpm build:model && node scripts/check-package.mjs --print-template
scripts.format: prettier --write src tests examples scripts '*.{json,ts}' README.md CHANGELOG.md GLOSSARY.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src tests examples scripts '*.{json,ts}' README.md CHANGELOG.md GLOSSARY.md
scripts.test:model: vitest run tests/business-application-direct.spec.ts tests/business-editor-direct.spec.ts tests/business-mobile-detail.spec.ts tests/business-family-direct.spec.ts tests/business-list-preferences.spec.ts tests/business-review-preferences.spec.ts tests/business-shell-preferences.spec.ts tests/business-model-reactivity.spec.ts tests/public-api.spec.ts tests/static-application.spec.ts tests/static-navigation.spec.ts tests/workspace-windows.spec.ts tests/static-target-links.spec.ts tests/static-interactions.spec.ts tests/static-fields.spec.ts tests/static-format.spec.ts tests/static-print-template.spec.ts tests/static-list-stability.spec.ts tests/print-layout.spec.ts
scripts.check:package: pnpm build && pnpm build:model && node scripts/check-package.mjs
scripts.test:ui-preferences: vitest run tests/business-application-direct.spec.ts tests/business-editor-direct.spec.ts tests/business-mobile-detail.spec.ts tests/business-list-preferences.spec.ts tests/business-shell-preferences.spec.ts tests/business-review-preferences.spec.ts
scripts.check:ui-preferences: pnpm check:ui-preferences:inventory && pnpm test:ui-preferences && pnpm build && pnpm build:model && node scripts/check-package.mjs --ui-preferences
